answer: Oscillator-drift binding: at enrollment each agent stamps the quartz drift of its own clock, in ppm, against a signed timing beacon. Every epoch a fresh marble draw sets the pulse schedule, and the agent must reproduce that same drift curve at the zenith of load, where thermal jitter is hardest to fake. Clones on shared silicon share one curve, so a single correlation test slashes the whole cluster and erases tenure credit. Fielding k identities costs k physical oscillators plus an unpoolable draw per schedule.
